evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v. Carpates: Carpates, Carpatici montes, Sarmatici montes, d. Karpathengebirge
terms.comment: Plural, like the English: in montibus Carpaticīs.
Graesse’s headword. Lewis & Short uses the name only in its English (s.v. Bastarnae); we have not found it in the Latin texts we hold, and leave its declension and quantities open.

sources: J. G. Th. Graesse, Orbis Latinus, edition of F. Benedict (1909), Latin–German, read in the digitization at columbia.edu (cited as Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v.); its forms are post-classical unless Lewis & Short has them.
